slides.title: Two different peptides, sold as one
slides.text: CJC-1295 is meant to trigger growth hormone release, Ipamorelin to mimic ghrelin. Sellers bundle them into a single blend.
The main human data on CJC-1295 comes from a single 2006 study — and only for the DAC form, not the 'no-DAC' version most shops actually sell.
No controlled study has tested CJC-1295 and Ipamorelin together. Ipamorelin's own human data comes mainly from post-surgery gut motility studies, not fitness or performance.
